name: NK2 homeobox 1

function.text: NKX2-1 encodes homeobox protein Nkx-2.1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to NKX2-1 related choreoathetosis and congenital hypothyroidism with or without pulmonary dysfunction (autosomal dominant); brain-lung-thyroid syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Low-Grade Glioma, NOS. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
